gen-gf-happy-monkey-gf-sawarabi-gothic: Wiry, wide-grinning letters take the lead in Happy Monkey. Sawarabi Gothic sits beneath it as a sans with open curves, and it holds up fine at a modest size.
gen-gf-shantell-sans-gf-encode-sans-semi: Loose and handwritten, Shantell Sans keeps one pen width throughout, its n arches no thinner than the stems beside them. Encode Sans Semi Condensed then reads smoothly down a page, narrow and approachable.
